_comment: eBay categories proven NOT to render a fitment table. Rows pushed here are stored and read back fine but are never SHOWN, whatever we send -- verified 2026-08-25 by pushing Rule A (trimless, catalog-valid) rows and re-reading hours later: SKU 30825 stored 24 vehicles and displayed 0, 26019 stored 30 and displayed 0. An earlier theory that these were merely mis-classified as engine parts is WRONG: fixing the classification changed nothing. ebay_batch skips them BEFORE the Trading guard read, so each one saves a call against the 5,000/day GetItem cap as well as a pointless write. Only categories with skus_seen >= skip_threshold are skipped, so a single unlucky listing cannot silently disable a whole category. To re-test one (eBay may enable fitment later), delete its entry here and let the next sweep push into it again.
